interpretation.plain_speak: The temporary trace survives right up to 31 occupied history slots. The next qualified insertion fills the table and forces replacement; because the target is the oldest age-2 trace, it is the one evicted. This is a hard capacity boundary in the tested setup.
interpretation.north_star_question: Pins the interaction between temporal aging and finite history-table competition to an exact tested occupancy boundary, making long-stream forgetting predictable rather than merely statistical.
interpretation.next_stage: hold the same full-table pressure fixed while varying the target history age at the replacement event to test whether age rank, rather than target identity or occupancy alone, determines survival
